counterfactual_missing_items: Initial creatinine kinase (CK) level: 22,000 IU/L, later peaked at >40,000 IU/L
Right biceps femoris biopsy: Nonspecific myopathic changes consistent with rhabdomyolysis
decisive_items: Biliary stricture biopsy: Consistent with adenocarcinoma
CT abdomen/pelvis: 2.6 × 3.1 cm pancreatic head mass with associated pancreatic ductal dilatation
BiliSeq genetic sequencing: Demonstrated genomic alterations in targeted regions of genes involved in biliary-tract malignancies
response.rationale: R4 is the champion because it has direct evidence of adenocarcinoma from the biliary stricture biopsy and a pancreatic head mass with associated pancreatic ductal dilatation. R3 is the runner-up because it has genetic sequencing results demonstrating genomic alterations in genes involved in biliary-tract malignancies, but it is not as specific as R4's findings.

rejected.why: R1 is rejected because while it has elevated CK levels and biopsy findings consistent with rhabdomyolysis, it does not explain the pancreatic head mass or the biliary stricture biopsy results.
R2 is rejected because while it has a possible mechanism for myopathy, it does not explain the pancreatic head mass or the biliary stricture biopsy results.
